title: B2B Sales Executive
description:
We are seeking a motivated and results-driven B2B Sales Executive to join our dynamic sales team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth by identifying new business opportunities and building strong relationships with clients. This role requires a proactive approach to lead generation and a deep understanding of the sales process in a B2B environment. Key Responsibilities: - Identify and pursue new business opportunities through various channels, including networking, cold calling, and referrals. - Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions. - Conduct market research to identify potential clients and industry trends. - Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations to prospective clients. - Negotiate contracts and close deals to achieve sales targets. - Collaborate with the marketing team to develop strategies for lead generation and brand awareness. - Maintain accurate records of sales activities and client interactions in the CRM system. - Provide exceptional customer service and support to ensure client satisfaction and retention. Required Skills: - Proven experience in commercial sales, particularly in a B2B context. - Strong business development and lead generation skills. - Excellent client handling and customer relationship management abilities. - Proficient in sales coordination and negotiation techniques. - Ability to follow up effectively and manage multiple leads simultaneously. - Strong communication and interpersonal skills. - Self-motivated with a results-oriented mindset. If you are passionate about sales and eager to contribute to a growing organization, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us in driving success and delivering value to our clients.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Field Sales Executive to join our dynamic team in Haryana. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in sales, particularly in the print media and printing industry. As a Field Sales Executive, you will be responsible for driving sales growth, building relationships with clients, and providing exceptional sales support. Key Responsibilities: - Develop and implement effective sales strategies to achieve sales targets in the print media sector. - Conduct field visits to potential and existing clients to promote our printing services and products. - Coordinate with the production team to ensure timely delivery of print materials and services. - Provide sales support by addressing client inquiries and resolving issues promptly. - Maintain accurate records of sales activities and client interactions in the CRM system. - Collaborate with the marketing team to align sales efforts with promotional campaigns. - Attend industry events and trade shows to network and promote our brand. Required Skills: - Proven experience in sales, preferably in field sales within the print media or printing industry. - Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with clients. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. - Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. - Proficiency in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite. - A proactive approach to problem-solving and a results-oriented mindset. If you are passionate about sales and have a keen interest in the print industry, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to contribute to our company's success.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Sales Executive
description:

Sales Executive

**Company:**
Expert Sales Solution

**Location:**
Near Gandhi Chowk, Sonipat, Haryana (on-site)

3–4

Male / Female

title: Business Development Manager - MarTech (Retail)
description:
**Key Accountabilities**
* Drive new business opportunities for MarTech, loyalty, and customer engagement solutions across CPG brands, grocery chains, and food retail ecosystems.
* Build and manage a qualified pipeline within key segments such as modern trade, supermarkets, hypermarkets, convenience stores, and D2C food brands.
* Identify decision\-makers across marketing, digital, loyalty, CRM, e\-commerce, and shopper marketing teams.
* Develop and execute go\-to\-market strategies tailored to CPG and grocery use cases.
* Lead end\-to\-end sales cycles including discovery, solution positioning, proposal development, and commercial negotiations.
* Position solutions around core industry KPIs such as repeat purchase, basket size, frequency, customer lifetime value, and trade promotion effectiveness.
* Work closely with product, presales, and delivery teams to craft targeted value propositions, demos, and business cases.
* Build strategic partnerships with CPG ecosystem players, retail tech vendors, data providers, and system integrators.
* Track trends in grocery, omnichannel retail, digital coupons, loyalty, and shopper engagement to refine sales strategy.
* Contribute to account planning, pipeline forecasting, and revenue targets.
* Provide market feedback to product teams based on client needs and competitive insights.


**Mandatory Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or related field.
* Experience: 8\-10 years in Business Development, Sales, or Account Management.
* Proven experience selling MarTech, loyalty, shopper engagement, or digital commerce solutions.
* Direct exposure to CPG, grocery, or food retail clients.
* Experience in consultative, solution, or value\-based selling.
* Ability to build and manage complex sales pipelines.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams including product, presales, and delivery.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills.
* High ownership mindset with strong commercial acumen.


**Desirable Skills**
* Experience selling to large grocery chains, food retailers, or global CPG brands.
* Exposure to digital coupons, loyalty platforms, CDPs, campaign management, or personalization engines.
* Familiarity with trade promotion management or retail media ecosystems.
* Experience in SaaS or subscription\-based MarTech solutions.
* Understanding of data, analytics, and AI\-driven shopper marketing.
* Existing network within the grocery or CPG ecosystem.

title: Relationship Manager Yes Premia
description:
**Role Summary**
 The role holder is responsible for deepening existing client relationships or acquiring those that are new to bank. The incumbent must act as a one point of contact for managed clients and leverage opportunities to increase overall wallet share in accordance with the financial needs of the customer.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Relationship Management** 
 :
   

  

  Manages the banking and investments relationship and is responsible for overall growth of Liabilities \& Investment business from branch/retail customers
   

  

  Develops, manages, and expands customer relationships by providing service level which exceeds client expectations of most important customer segment
   

  

  Identifies current and potential relationship with additional revenue potential and grow business volumes for larger share of customer wallet
   

  

**Generating Incremental Business**
  Sales targets spread across liabilities, retail assets, business banking, forex, cards, investments etc
   

  

  Proactively sells the full range of consumer and commercial product to current and potential Relationships
   

  

  Deepens existing relationships or acquires new customers to Increase CASA balance in allocated portfolio
   

  

  Drives higher product and channel penetration to deepen mapped relationships and to increase customer relationship value with the bank
   

  

**Customer Engagement**
  Ensures portfolio quality by regularly engaging with each mapped relationship and maintaining the desired relationship values
   

  

**Investments**
  Analyses financial needs of the customers and offer appropriate product with utmost transparency
   

  

  Drives revenue business to generate fee income through products like mutual funds, investments and insurance
   

  

**Audit \& Compliance**
  Adheres to the Bank’s policy on acquisition/BSA/KYC etc as well as compliance requirements of regulatory authorities (RBI/SEBI/AMFI/IRDA, etc)
   

  

**Self\-management Responsibilities**
 Defines performance goals at the start of the year in discussion with the reporting manager and ensures that the goals are monitored and achieved during the course of the year.
   

  

  Takes ownership of his/her own learning agenda by identifying development needs in consultation with the reporting manager and working towards bridging the gaps through various means which go beyond just training.
   

  

  Understands the competencies relevant to his/her role, and works towards displaying as well as developing these effectively.
   

  

  Keeps abreast of relevant professional/industry developments, new techniques and current issues through continued education and professional networks.
   

  

**Risk control compliance**
  Follows risk policy and processes to mitigate the operational, regulatory, financial, informational, reputational and audit risks as instructed by the departmental manager.
   

  

  Executes the established internal control systems and compiles relevant information for departmental audits, as necessary.
   

  

**Knowledge And Experience**
  Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
   

  

  AMFI/NCFM/IRDA certifications will be an added advantage
   

  

  Minimum of 4\-6 years of relevant experience with at least 1\-2 years in a similar role

title: GM Sales & Operation
description:
General Manager – Sales \& Operations
 
**Industry:** 
 Automobile / Commercial Vehicle Dealership
 



**Experience:** 
 12–18 Years (Same Industry Preferred)
 



**Location:** 
 Bahadurgarh, Haryana
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary:** 
 16 LPA (Negotiable)
 



**Notice Period:** 
 Preferred Immediate Joiner
 



  




 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a
 **General Manager – Sales \& Operations** 
 to lead both
 **business growth and operational excellence** 
 for a commercial vehicle dealership.
 



 This is a
 **100% outcome\-oriented leadership role** 
 , where success will be measured through business results rather than activity completion.
 



 The ideal candidate will be a
 **Business Growth Driver \+ Operational Excellence Owner** 
 , capable of driving sales, market expansion, customer experience, profitability, workshop performance, and leadership accountability.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  





**Sales \& Business Growth** 



* Own New CV Sales revenue, volume, and business targets.
* Drive territory expansion, market share, fleet, institutional and key\-account business.
* Improve enquiry\-to\-booking and booking\-to\-retail conversion.
* Strengthen relationships with OEMs, major customers and strategic accounts.
* Build a strong, measurable sales pipeline and improve salesperson productivity.



**Operations \& Business Excellence** 



* Oversee operations across
 **4 workshops** 
 and ensure smooth business execution.
* Improve workshop productivity, vehicle throughput, bay utilisation and technician productivity.
* Control VOR ageing, operational bottlenecks and avoidable costs.
* Ensure DMS, SOP, OEM and compliance discipline.
* Improve customer satisfaction and resolve escalations through root\-cause action.
* Optimise spares, inventory, receivables and working capital.



**Leadership \& Business Management** 



* Lead Sales, Service, Spares and support\-function heads through clear business outcomes.
* Conduct structured weekly and monthly business reviews.
* Take corrective action when business targets are missed.
* Build a high\-performance culture with strong accountability and succession planning.
* Represent the organisation with OEMs, customers, vendors and key stakeholders.


 Key Success Measures
 
  





 The position will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
 


* Revenue \& PBT growth
* New CV Sales achievement
* Market share and territory penetration
* Sales conversion and team productivity
* Workshop productivity and utilisation
* VOR ageing control
* Customer satisfaction / CSI / VOC
* Cost and working\-capital optimisation
* Dealer / OEM audit and process compliance
* Employee retention and leadership pipeline


 Candidate Profile
 
  





 We are looking for a
 **Business Leader rather than a pure Sales Head or Operations Head** 
 .
 



**Ideal background:** 



* 12–18 years of experience in automobile dealership / OEM / commercial vehicle business.
* 4–5\+ years in GM, Business Head, Senior Sales Head, Operations Head or equivalent leadership role.
* Strong experience across
 **Sales \+ Service \+ Spares / dealership operations** 
 .
* Experience managing large teams and multiple locations.
* Strong understanding of dealership MIS, DMS and business dashboards.
* Proven exposure to market expansion, key accounts and business growth.
* Strong commercial understanding with hands\-on operational orientation.
* Experience with
 **Tata Motors, Ashok Leyland, Mahindra, Eicher\-Volvo or similar CV dealership environment** 
 will be preferred.


 Qualification
 
  




* MBA / PGDM in Sales \& Marketing, Operations, General Management or equivalent.
* Automobile / Mechanical Engineering qualification will be an advantage.



  




 Who Should Apply?
 
  





 This opportunity is suited for a senior automotive leader who can move seamlessly between
 **market growth, customer relationships, sales performance, workshop operations, profitability and people leadership** 
 .
 



 If you have a strong track record of
 **owning business outcomes and leading multi\-functional dealership operations** 
 , we would like to hear from you.
 



**Apply now / Share your profile with us at 8982006574\.**
